bookTitle: A Complete Guide To Volume Price Analysis

facts.statement: Testing is a critical phase executed by market insiders after an accumulation or distribution campaign to verify whether unabsorbed supply or demand remains before launching a major markup or markdown price trend.

sourceCitation.book: A Complete Guide To Volume Price Analysis
sourceCitation.excerpt: Testing is a critical phase executed by market insiders (specialists, market makers, or large operators) after an accumulation or distribution campaign.

facts.statement: Following accumulation, insiders face the risk of unabsorbed selling pressure knocking prices back down; to prevent this, they execute a test of supply by marking prices lower to check if all floating supply was absorbed.

sourceCitation.book: A Complete Guide To Volume Price Analysis
sourceCitation.excerpt: Following an accumulation phase, insiders face a major risk... If unabsorbed selling pressure ('supply') remains... insiders execute a test of supply to check whether all supply has been absorbed.

facts.statement: A successful test of supply is characterized by a narrow spread candle with a deep lower wick accompanied by low or below-average volume, proving that very few sellers remain and old supply was fully absorbed.

sourceCitation.book: A Complete Guide To Volume Price Analysis
sourceCitation.excerpt: The candle displays a narrow spread body... with a deep lower wick, accompanied by low or below-average volume... proves that very few sellers remain and that old supply was completely mopped up.

facts.statement: A failed test of supply occurs when marking prices lower generates high or above-average volume, signaling that old sellers are returning in large numbers and supply was not fully absorbed, forcing insiders to restart congestion.

sourceCitation.book: A Complete Guide To Volume Price Analysis
sourceCitation.excerpt: Marking the price lower yields high or above-average volume... signals that sellers from the old trading range are returning in large numbers... insiders quickly retreat, moving the price back into the sideways congestion.

facts.statement: Coulling compares insider testing to a commercial test marketing campaign, where a company tests price points and messaging on a small scale to ensure market receptivity before launching full product distribution.

sourceCitation.book: A Complete Guide To Volume Price Analysis
sourceCitation.excerpt: Insiders run a small test marketing campaign (like a retail company testing price points and messaging on a small scale) to ensure the market is receptive before launching a full product distribution.

facts.statement: At the culmination of distribution, insiders test demand by marking prices higher to verify whether retail buying pressure remains before initiating a fast price markdown back to wholesale levels.

sourceCitation.book: A Complete Guide To Volume Price Analysis
sourceCitation.excerpt: At the culmination of a distribution phase... before starting a markdown campaign... insiders must verify that no lingering buying pressure ('demand') remains... insiders mark the price higher.

facts.statement: A successful test of demand occurs when price moves higher but closes near the open on very low volume, confirming that retail buying demand is exhausted and allowing insiders to initiate a rapid price markdown.

sourceCitation.book: A Complete Guide To Volume Price Analysis
sourceCitation.excerpt: The candle moves higher but falls back to close at or near its opening level, accompanied by very low volume... Low volume confirms that retail buying demand is exhausted... Insiders can safely initiate a fast price markdown.

facts.statement: A failed test of demand occurs when marking prices higher is met with high volume, indicating that retail buyers are still flooding into the market and forcing insiders to return prices to distribution congestion for further absorption.

sourceCitation.book: A Complete Guide To Volume Price Analysis
sourceCitation.excerpt: The price is marked higher and is met with high volume... indicates that retail buyers are still flooding into the market... Insiders must move the market back into the distribution congestion area.

facts.statement: Market structure is fractal: accumulation, distribution, testing, and breakout cycles occur across all timeframes from tick charts to monthly charts, mirroring nested Russian Matryoshka dolls.

sourceCitation.book: A Complete Guide To Volume Price Analysis
sourceCitation.excerpt: Market structure is fractal: accumulation, distribution, testing, and breakout cycles occur across all timeframes... mirroring nested Russian dolls.

facts.statement: A minor reversal built on a few candles on a fast chart has little energy stored, but when a sentiment shift ripples into slower timeframes, it is like winding a clockwork car tighter, resulting in a trend with much further to run.

sourceCitation.book: A Complete Guide To Volume Price Analysis
sourceCitation.excerpt: A minor reversal built on a few candles on a fast chart has little energy stored. But when a sentiment shift ripples through into slower timeframes, it is like winding up a clockwork car tighter.

facts.statement: Traders must triangulate trade risk and distinguish pullbacks from reversals by analyzing three timeframes simultaneously, utilizing specific pairings such as scalp sets (1m, 5m, 15m), swing sets (1h, 4h, daily), or trend sets (4h, daily, weekly).

sourceCitation.book: A Complete Guide To Volume Price Analysis
sourceCitation.excerpt: Traders must 'triangulate' their analysis using three timeframes... Scalper Set: 1-minute, 5-minute, and 15-minute... Swing Trader Set: 60-minute, 240-minute, and daily... Trend Trader Set: 4-hour, daily, and weekly.

facts.topic: Duke Energy Daily Chart Testing Case
facts.statement: On the Duke Energy daily chart, following a price waterfall decline, stopping volume and consolidation appeared before a successful low-volume test candle confirmed absorption, prompting a gap-up breakout on high volume.

sourceCitation.book: A Complete Guide To Volume Price Analysis
sourceCitation.excerpt: Following a price waterfall decline, stopping volume appeared, followed by consolidation and a low-volume test candle... prompting a gap-up breakout on high volume.

generalAssumptions: Market price manipulation is structurally transparent on the volume tape.
Effort versus result governs institutional capital movement.
